requirements.text: SELECT position, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY position
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE nationality != '' GROUP BY nationality
SELECT p.team, AVG(p.nba_championships) AS avg_championships FROM player p JOIN team t ON p.team = t.team_name GROUP BY p.team
SELECT college, MAX(mvp_awards) AS max_mvp_awards FROM player WHERE college != '' GROUP BY college HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT position, SUM(mvp_awards) AS total_mvp_awards FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY position
SELECT nationality, MAX(nba_championships) AS max_championships FROM player WHERE nba_championships >= 1 AND nationality != '' GROUP BY nationality
SELECT draft_year, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE draft_year > 2010 GROUP BY draft_year
SELECT p.team, MIN(p.draft_pick) AS earliest_draft_pick FROM player p JOIN team t ON p.team = t.team_name WHERE p.draft_pick > 0 GROUP BY p.team
SELECT position, AVG(olympic_gold_medals) AS avg_olympic_golds FROM player WHERE olympic_gold_medals >= 1 AND position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY position
SELECT college, COUNT(*) AS champion_count FROM player WHERE nba_championships >= 1 AND college != '' GROUP BY college
SELECT p.team, SUM(p.fiba_world_cup) AS total_fiba_titles FROM player p JOIN team t ON p.team = t.team_name WHERE p.fiba_world_cup >= 1 GROUP BY p.team
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE age BETWEEN 20 AND 40 AND nationality != '' GROUP BY nationality
SELECT location, MAX(championship) AS max_championships FROM team WHERE location != '' GROUP BY location
SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM team WHERE founded_year < 1970 AND location != '' GROUP BY location
SELECT ownership, SUM(championship) AS total_championships FROM team WHERE ownership != '' GROUP BY ownership
SELECT location, AVG(championship) AS avg_championships FROM team WHERE championship >= 1 AND location != '' GROUP BY location
SELECT nationality, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM owner GROUP BY nationality
SELECT nationality, MIN(own_year) AS earliest_own_year FROM owner WHERE own_year >= 2000 GROUP BY nationality
SELECT state_name, AVG(population) AS avg_population FROM city WHERE state_name != '' GROUP BY state_name
SELECT state_name, MAX(gdp) AS max_gdp FROM city WHERE population > 1000000 AND state_name != '' GROUP BY state_name
